mapper.select: SELECT StoryCount, PublishedStoryCount, ChapterCount, WordCount, ViewCount, FollowerCount, StoryFollowCount, RatingCount, RatingAvg FROM dbo.vw_AuthorStats WHERE AuthorId = #{authorId}

SELECT AS Period, SUM(CAST(d.Views AS BIGINT)) AS Views FROM dbo.StoryViewDaily d JOIN dbo.Story s ON s.StoryId = d.StoryId WHERE s.AuthorId = #{authorId} AND s.IsDeleted = 0 AND d.ViewDate BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND d.StoryId = #{storyId} GROUP BY ORDER BY Period

SELECT , COALESCE(v.Views, 0) AS Views30d, CASE WHEN s.RatingCount > 0 AND s.RatingAvg > (SELECT AVG(s2.RatingAvg) FROM dbo.Story s2 WHERE s2.AuthorId = s.AuthorId AND s2.IsDeleted = 0 AND s2.RatingCount > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AboveMyAverage
OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(CAST(d.Views AS BIGINT)) AS Views FROM dbo.StoryViewDaily d WHERE d.StoryId = s.StoryId AND d.ViewDate >= #{since}) v WHERE s.AuthorId = #{authorId} AND s.IsDeleted = 0 ORDER BY s.ViewCount DESC, s.StoryId
SELECT a.FollowerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.AuthorFollow f WHERE f.AuthorId = a.UserId AND f.CreatedAt >= #{since}) AS NewFollowers FROM dbo.Author a WHERE a.UserId = #{authorId}

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) u.UserId, u.Username, u.DisplayName, u.AvatarUrl, f.CreatedAt AS FollowedAt FROM dbo.AuthorFollow f JOIN dbo.[User] u ON u.UserId = f.FollowerId WHERE f.AuthorId = #{authorId} ORDER BY f.CreatedAt DESC, f.FollowerId DESC
SELECT TOP (#{limit}) StoryId, Title, Slug, FollowCount FROM dbo.Story WHERE AuthorId = #{authorId} AND IsDeleted = 0 AND FollowCount > 0 ORDER BY FollowCount DESC, StoryId
